buy_day_seal_rate.formula: bought samples whose buy day finally closed at limit / all bought samples

low_open_board_rate.formula: low-open bought samples sealed on buy day and finally sealed next trading day / all low-open bought samples

low_open_close_red_rate.formula: low-open bought samples with next-day close strictly above buy-day close / all low-open bought samples

low_open_final_limit_down_rate.formula: low-open bought samples whose next-day final close equals limit-down / all low-open bought samples

next_day_board_rate.formula: bought samples sealed on buy day and finally sealed again next trading day / all bought samples

tail_sell_return.formula: Arithmetic mean of stored per-trade return percentages; fees, tax and slippage follow the plan definition.

win_rate.formula: tail-sell samples with return above zero / bought samples with a recorded tail-sell return
